package: PDIP-8 (P); the same pinout in SOIC-8 (D: NE5534D, NE5534DR) and SO-8 (PS)

needs.source: TI SLOS070D, 8.1: compensated internally for a gain equal to or greater than three, an external compensation capacitor between COMP and COMP/BAL; 7.5 and 7.6: the unity-gain characteristics (unity-gain bandwidth, rise time and overshoot at AVD = 1) are specified with CC = 22 pF
TI SLOS070D, 10 Power Supply Recommendations: 0.1-µF bypass capacitors close to the power-supply pins

compensated.about: a gain below 3 – unity gain, a follower: the external compensation capacitor CC between COMP (5) and COMP/BAL (8), 22 pF as the datasheet specifies the unity-gain characteristics with (SLOS070D 7.5, 7.6, 8.1)

hints: compensated internally for a gain of 3 or more; below that – a follower, a buffer – CC between COMP (5) and COMP/BAL (8), 22 pF for unity gain (8.1, 7.5): give the component config "compensated" and the capacitor; TI's typical application 9.2 draws a voltage follower without CC, the description and the characteristics are followed here
inputs: protection diodes between them – more than about 0.6 V between IN+ and IN− draws excessive current unless a resistor limits it (7.1 note 4), input current at most ±10 mA
offset null: a potentiometer between BALANCE (1) and COMP/BAL (8) with its wiper to VCC+ (figure 10)

compliance.source: TI SLOS070D: a low-noise operational amplifier, no transmitter – read 2026-10-31; RoHS and REACH not read (TI's material content pages were not opened)

sources: TI NE5534x, SA5534x data sheet SLOS070D (July 1979, revised November 2014), from TI https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ne5534.pdf, read 2026-10-31

pins: 6 Pin Configuration and Functions p. 3, D (SOIC), P (PDIP) or PS (SOP): 1 BALANCE, 2 IN−, 3 IN+, 4 VCC−, 5 COMP, 6 OUT, 7 VCC+, 8 COMP/BAL; BALANCE and COMP/BAL external frequency compensation and offset adjustment, COMP offset adjustment (pin functions table) – typed passive: they take the compensation capacitor and the offset potentiometer, no logic level
VCC− typed ground with the role vee (the op-amp model's negative rail): a single-supply design ties it to ground, a split supply decouples it as well (10)

vin_rel_max_v 0 and v_min_v 0 on IN+ and IN− (against VCC−, the part's ground pin): 7.1 input voltage, either input, VCC− … VCC+; i_inject_max_a 0.01 on IN+ and IN−: 7.1 input current −10 … 10 mA
vicm_v [3, -3]: 7.5 common-mode input-voltage range ±12 V min at VCC± = ±15 V – 3 V from each rail; vout_swing_v [3, -3]: 7.5 maximum peak-to-peak output swing 24 V min at ±15 V, RL ≥ 600 Ω – ±12 V
iq_a 0.008: 7.5 total supply current 4 typ / 8 max mA at VO = 0, no load, 25 °C
tj_max_c 150: 7.1; t_min_c 0, t_max_c 70: 7.3 operating free-air temperature of the NE5534 (SA5534: −40 … 85 °C); rth_ja_k_per_w 85: 7.4 RθJA of the P package (D 97, PS 95 °C/W)

notes: Low-noise bipolar op-amp (3.5 nV/√Hz), compensated internally for a gain of 3 or more – below that it needs the external compensation capacitor CC between COMP and COMP/BAL (maker-coverage CK-28: the external compensation a part requires, as a pin need of the config compensated).
